$comment: Source for docs/REQUIREMENTS_TRACEABILITY.md (npm run orchestrate -- --trace). Status: implemented | partial | pending | blocked. Evidence paths must exist; the orchestrator checks them. 'tests' names test titles that must appear in tests/.

shows an ending with endings found and play again

matches known vectors

never overwrites an approved version; edits need a higher version
requires a higher story version for each revision and after publication

The app records the parent’s confirmation but cannot verify the AI review records, which are kept in the job files
Parent gate is a PIN convenience lock, not authentication

requirements.title: Typing practice reports accuracy and speed, kept apart from reading
tests: gross words a minute is keystrokes over five, per minute up to the latest key
a mistake lowers net speed: speed is gross words a minute times accuracy
a faster speed gives a shorter lap, for the same words
a faster typist finishes the same lap in less time
keeps a high score list for each race track, separate from the others
types the words from the list, shows speed and accuracy, and finishes the lap
the car starts on the line at the left and drives to the right
a finished lap leaves the car at the finish line, the far end of the road
each road keeps its own high scores, and changing road starts a new lap
gaps: Speed is measured to the latest key, so it does not fall while the reader pauses
Speed appears only on the typing screen and in its high scores; it is never reported as reading fluency
Speed is not recorded in progress and does not feed skill evidence (R27)
No timer ends or limits a lap; a timer for typing, if ever added, must be off by default and never affect reading
